title: Smooth Hover Underline Effects (with Box-Shadow) - Webflow
desc:
Today, we’ll build a set of hover underline animations in Webflow — powered by box-shadow and smooth CSS transitions.

You’ll learn how to:

✅ Create a growing underline from the bottom
✅ Animate from the top, left, and right
✅ Build a full-height underline effect
✅ Even animate multiple borders at once with a simple trick

No custom code needed — just smart use of styles and transitions.

👉 Watch on YouTube: https://youtu.be/bTXWsrMSPaY

title: Box Shadows in Webflow - Webflow
desc:
Convert values from Figma, and paste into your site for precise drop shadows every time.

Supports pasting CSS directly from tools like Figma. A huge time saver for me and entirely removes the guess work 👌

Generate global combo classes from multiple layered shadows.

Layers in shadows give design depth and dimension. 

Another use case: Generate your shadows on https://shadows.brumm.af, then 1-click import by pasting the CSS.

title: Subscription Pricing - Webflow
desc:
Happy Thursday! I took some time to revise one of Flowbase's open-source projects and added Memberstack to it. I removed/renamed a few classes, updated the page copy, change font sizes to make the prices feel smaller, and added Memberstack links to 2 of the buttons. You'll need to hook the contact us button up to your chat app, contact form, or email. 

Note: you could use this template with Memberstack's pre-built UI (the one you see in the template now) or you could link directly to your own custom signup form. Totally up to you.

If you have any questions, feel free to drop a comment below. Thanks!
